## Phase: 39 - Resilience & Health Probes

### jq fail-open guard pattern
from: [[decision:jq-hook-migration]]
retrieved: 2026-05-25

- Guard: `command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0` at top of hook
- Established Phase 24, used by 8 hooks — new jq hooks MUST include it
- INPUT= assignment must come AFTER the guard (not before)

### PostToolUse field path inconsistency
from: [[decision:posttooluse-field-path-inconsistency]]
retrieved: 2026-05-25

- 3 hooks use `.input.file_path` (audit-log, auto-ruff, scan-secrets)
- 2 hooks use `.tool_input` (post-commit, stale-queue)
- Both patterns work; live verification needed before normalizing
- Eval schema at eval/schemas/post-tool-use.json says `.tool_input`

### Hook fixes require tmpdir testing
from: [[decision:hook-reconciliation-approach]]
retrieved: 2026-05-25

- Every hook fix must be tested in mktemp -d before touching live state
- Prevents self-lockout via enforce-spec.sh regression
- Evidence-pinned: commit message needs quoted error string or lint finding

### 3-layer health probe architecture
from: [[decision:health-probe-3-layer]]
retrieved: 2026-05-25

- Layer 1: jq reads settings.json (.mcpServers.memory.command, .mcpServers.memory.cwd)
- Layer 2: $MCP_CMD -c "import memory_server" functional check
- Layer 3: sqlite3 entry count with graceful fallback if sqlite3/DB absent
- 3-state output: healthy (N entries) / broken (reason) / not configured
